experiment_a.rule: lowest mean development log loss at +1.5 s across the three chronological folds; the same setting is used at every horizon

experiment_b.rule: lowest mean validation log loss over the three chronological folds (averaged over the four prefixes); epochs = median best epoch

note: Weeks 15-18 were examined during v1. Everything below on those weeks is a comparison on a previously examined benchmark.
decision_rule: Lean: man if calibrated p(man) >= class threshold (0.5 unless the balanced policy is supported). Confidence = max(p, 1 - p). Abstain when confidence < the cutoff chosen on weeks 13-14.

balanced_policy.rule: maximize balanced accuracy on weeks 13-14 subject to man precision >= 0.8

cutoff.rule: lowest cutoff with calibration-week accepted accuracy >= 0.9 and >= 20% accepted
